answer: E78 resists sybils by fingerprint-dedup. Each identity locks timber, a per-output bond, before work counts. A falcon daemon hashes each submission's input, method and output; colliding fingerprints void both payments there, timber slashed to honest peers. N clones need N bonds yet forfeit N-1 payments per batch because shared pipelines collide; an honest specialist posts one timber and never collides - cost cannot amortize. Each task's plume, its signed producer-sealer chain, must fork per identity, so pooling puppets means forging signatures costlier than honest work.
